items.question: What is Leaving Egypt?
items.answer: Leaving Egypt is a Christ-centered men's organization and brotherhood. We help men leave behind what has kept them stuck and grow in four areas that shape a man's life: Faith, Family, Fitness, and Finance. We do that through biblical teaching, honest friendship, and practical steps.

items.question: Who is Leaving Egypt for?
items.answer: It's for adult men at any stage of faith who want to grow—whether you feel spiritually distant, carry regret, feel isolated, or simply sense that something needs to change. You don't need to have it all together. You just need to be willing to take an honest first step.

items.question: Do I need to be a business owner?
items.answer: No. Leaving Egypt is for men from all walks of life. The Finance pillar is about wise stewardship and integrity with what you have—not about running a business or building wealth.

items.question: Do I need to belong to a specific denomination?
items.answer: No. Men come to us from many church backgrounds. Our Statement of Faith focuses on the core beliefs shared by Christians across traditions, and we stay away from narrow or partisan positions. If you're still exploring faith, you're welcome too.

items.question: Is Leaving Egypt a church?
items.answer: No. We're a brotherhood that walks alongside the local church—never a replacement for it. We encourage every man to be part of a healthy local congregation.

items.question: Does Leaving Egypt replace counseling or professional care?
items.answer: No. We are not a substitute for licensed counseling, therapy, medical care, or crisis services. Brotherhood and encouragement are valuable, but some challenges need trained professionals—and asking for that help is a sign of strength, not weakness. If you're in immediate danger, call 988 (U.S. Suicide & Crisis Lifeline) or 911.

items.answer: [Add pricing or "free" status] Any cost to participate has not been set yet. We won't publish pricing until the organization confirms it.

items.question: What level of physical fitness is required?
items.answer: None. The Fitness pillar is about stewarding your body wisely at whatever stage you're in—not about a certain look or performance level. Always check with a qualified healthcare professional before starting any new fitness or wellness routine.

items.question: How is my personal information handled?
items.answer: We only use the information you send to respond to you. We don't sell it. Please review our [Privacy Policy](/privacy) for details, and avoid sending sensitive medical, financial, legal, or mental-health information through our forms.

items.question: Can I invite another man?
items.answer: Absolutely. Brotherhood grows when one man brings another along. Share the site, or point him to the [Begin Your Journey](/contact#interest) form.

items.question: How can a church or organization connect with Leaving Egypt?
items.answer: We'd welcome the conversation. Use the [Contact page](/contact) and choose "Church or organization partnership" as your reason for reaching out.
